This is a comprehensive smartwatch package designed to offer a blend of style, connectivity, and essential health features in a highly customizable format.

​ Design and Customization

  • ​Case & Build: Features a large 49MM Housing with a durable and lightweight Space Aluminum Case (also referred to as Zinc Alloy/Titanium finish), often sporting real screws on the back and a strap lock mechanism for a secure fit.
  • ​Display: Equipped with a vibrant and spacious IPS or AMOLED Display (typically 2.0-2.2 inches) with a high resolution for crisp, clear visuals. The screen often features a near-bezel-less ("Infinite") design.
  • ​The 10-in-1 Advantage: The main selling point is the included set of ten (10) interchangeable straps in various materials (like silicone, ocean, woven, leather, and steel) and colors, allowing the user to match the watch to any outfit or activity.

​ Core Functions & Connectivity

  • ​Bluetooth Calling: Built-in speaker and microphone enable you to make and receive phone calls directly from the watch when connected to your smartphone (Android or iOS).
  • ​Notifications: Stay connected with real-time alerts for calls, SMS, and popular social media apps.
  • ​App Integration: Connects to a companion app (often HiWatch Pro, QRunning, or Maitu Fit) to manage settings, view health data, and download customized 3D watch faces.
  • ​Hardware Features: Includes a fully functional rotating crown (side button) and a lag-free menu for smooth operation.

​ Health and Fitness Tracking

  • ​Health Monitoring: Acts as a complete health assistant, typically monitoring:
  • ​Heart Rate
  • ​Blood Oxygen (SpO_2)
  • ​Sleep Tracking
  • ​Pedometer (Step counter and calorie burned)
  • ​Sports Modes: Includes multiple pre-set Sports Modes to track specific activities like running, cycling, walking, and more.
  • ​Other Features: May include a Sedentary Reminder and an ECG monitor (though accuracy can vary in budget models).

​Power and Durability

  • ​Charging: Supports convenient Magnetic Wireless Charging.
  • ​Battery Life: Equipped with a powerful battery (e.g., 380mAh), offering an average of 2-3 days of usage and 5-7 days of standby time.
  • ​Water Resistance: Typically rated IP67 Life Waterproof or splash-resistant, making it suitable for everyday use (like hand washing and light rain) but not recommended for swimming, diving, or bathing.
